footer.about: Motor insurance management for Azerbaijan: policies, payments and claims in one place.
footer.legal: Portfolio project. Not a licensed insurer; quotes are illustrative of the pricing engine.

landing.heroLead: Motor insurance for Azerbaijan. Change any detail below and the PolisGo pricing engine reprices it instantly — with every factor on the table.

pricing.lead: One base rate, six multipliers, a cap on the extremes. The same arithmetic runs when a policy is issued — only then on verified data.

base.title: Base rate
base.body: Each product starts from its own rate: the cost of covering an average driver for a year.

risk.title: Five risk factors
risk.body: Engine capacity, driver age, years of experience, vehicle age and claims history each add a multiplier above or below ×1.00.

cap.title: A cap on risk
cap.body: The five risk multipliers are combined and held between ×0.50 and ×3.00, so no profile is priced out or given away.

term.title: Term
term.body: The price is pro-rated by month. Terms under twelve months carry a 10% loading for administration.

rounding.title: One rounding
rounding.body: Everything stays at full precision until the end, then the premium is rounded once, to the qiyəpik.

coverage.lead: Products and base rates come straight from the PolisGo API.
coverage.caption: Coverage by product

rows.thirdPartyProperty: Damage to other people’s vehicles and property
rows.ownDamage: Damage to your own car in an accident
rows.natural: Fire, flood, hail and other natural events

claims.lead: Four steps, each recorded in the claim’s history so you always know where it stands.

submit.title: Submit
submit.body: Report the incident online: the date, what happened, the amount, and photos or documents.

review.title: Review
review.body: An adjuster takes the claim, checks the documents and the policy, and keeps you informed.

decision.title: Decision
decision.body: An approved amount up to what you claimed, or a written reason if the claim is rejected.

payout.title: Payout
payout.body: Approved claims are paid out and marked paid. The full history stays on record.

final.q: Is the price on this page final?
final.a: No — it is an indicative estimate. When a policy is issued, the premium is recalculated from your verified customer and vehicle records.

differ.q: Why could my final premium differ?
differ.a: At issue the engine uses the data stored on your account, including approved or paid claims from the last three years, instead of what was typed into the calculator.

cap.a: The five risk factors are multiplied together and the result is kept between ×0.50 and ×3.00. It protects both very low-risk and very high-risk drivers from extreme prices.

term.q: Can I insure a car for less than a year?
term.a: Yes, for 1 to 12 months. The price is pro-rated by month, plus a 10% loading for terms shorter than a year.

claim.q: How do I make a claim?
claim.a: Sign in, choose the policy, describe the incident and upload photos or documents. An adjuster reviews it, and every status change is recorded.

licensed.a: No. PolisGo is a portfolio project that demonstrates an insurance platform; quotes illustrate its pricing engine.

calculator.diagramDesc: Each axis is one pricing factor. The dashed ring marks a neutral ×1.00; points outside it raise the premium, points inside lower it.

calculator.capHint: The combined risk factor ×{{raw}} was limited to ×{{capped}}.

modal.title: How the premium is calculated
modal.intro: The calculator sends your answers to the PolisGo pricing engine. The engine starts from the product's base rate and applies six multipliers.
modal.risk: Engine capacity, driver age, driving experience, vehicle age and claims history are multiplied into a single risk factor. That factor is capped between ×0.50 and ×3.00.
modal.term: The term factor pro-rates the price by months. Terms shorter than 12 months carry a 10% loading for administration.
modal.rounding: The premium is rounded once, at the end, to two decimals in AZN.
